jobs.title: VP, Finance ERP Implementation & Systems
jobs.description:
Overview:

We are a values driven organization putting **Relationships FIRST**. EagleBank (NASDAQ – EGBN) is focused on being **Flexible, Involved, Responsive, Strong, and Trusted**. By prioritizing meaningful connections with our customers, employees, and shareholders, we relentlessly deliver the most compelling, valuable service to our customers.  
  
EagleBank is committed to inclusion, equity, and respect. We celebrate diversity and intentionally seek out opportunities to learn from one another’s experience. We believe employees are essential to the building of relationships and we prioritize investing in employee growth and wellbeing. Employee involvement is fostered through resource groups, mentorship programs, community service, and scholarship opportunities for continued education. With features including maternity and parental leaves, wellness discounts, healthcare premium sharing, employer funding in your HSA account, and 100% 401(k) matching up to 4%, we pride ourselves in the ways we support our internal relationships. The minimum and maximum projected annualized salary for this position is: $114,071.00 to $192,797.00. Additional compensation may be possible based on experience and skills.

Responsibilities:

The **VP, Finance ERP Implementation & Systems** provides senior leadership for EagleBank's Finance ERP transformation, with primary accountability for the successful design, implementation, adoption, and stabilization of Workday Financials. The role leads the Finance workstream across accounting design, chart of accounts, data migration, process redesign, controls, integrations, testing, reporting, training, cutover, and go-live readiness. Following implementation, the position transitions into Finance and Accounting as the enterprise systems owner for the ERP, accountable for platform governance, optimization, financial systems strategy, reporting enablement, and the ongoing alignment of technology with controllership and business priorities. The successful candidate combines executive-level program leadership, strong accounting and controllership knowledge, and hands-on ERP implementation experience. The role serves as the primary connection among Finance, Accounting, Technology, EPMO, Risk, Internal Audit, business stakeholders, Workday, and the implementation partner, and provides clear decision support and escalation to executive governance.

**Major Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Executive ERP Program Leadership**

Own the Finance ERP implementation from mobilization through stabilization, including scope, roadmap, milestones, resource planning, budget coordination, dependencies, risks, issues, and business outcomes.

Lead the Finance and Accounting workstream and coordinate day-to-day execution across Workday, the implementation partner, Technology, EPMO, Risk, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders.

Establish program governance, decision rights, design authority, escalation protocols, and executive reporting for the Finance ERP transformation.

Provide clear recommendations to executive sponsors and governance committees on scope, design, risk, readiness, and key implementation decisions.

Hold internal and external workstream leaders accountable for deliverables, quality, timelines, and resolution of cross-functional dependencies.

**Finance and Accounting Design**

Lead the future-state design of core Finance and Accounting capabilities, including general ledger, accounts payable, procurement, cash management, fixed assets, budgeting, close, consolidation, reconciliation, and financial reporting. Lead the cleanup, rationalization, and redesign of the chart of accounts, financial dimensions, reporting hierarchies, accounting rules, and supporting data structures.

Partner with Finance leadership to translate accounting, controllership, management reporting, and regulatory requirements into scalable system and process designs.

Ensure the future-state design embeds appropriate internal controls, segregation of duties, auditability, approval authorities, and policy requirements.

**Data, Integrations, Reporting, and Controls**

Own the Finance data conversion strategy, including extraction, cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and archival of legacy financial data.

Provide business leadership for integrations between Workday Financials and banking, treasury, payroll, procurement, data, reporting, and other enterprise platforms.

Lead the Finance reporting inventory and future-state reporting architecture, including statutory, regulatory, management, operational, and ad hoc reporting needs.

Ensure data integrity, lineage, reconciliation, security, retention, privacy, and audit support throughout implementation and ongoing operations.

**Testing, Change, Cutover, and Adoption**

Own the end-to-end Finance testing strategy, including unit, system integration, user acceptance, parallel, regression, reporting, security, cutover, and post-production validation.

Lead Finance readiness for deployment, including procedures, training, communications, role definition, support models, cutover planning, and command-center coordination.

Define measurable readiness and acceptance criteria and provide an executive recommendation on go-live preparedness. Lead stabilization and adoption following launch, ensuring issues are prioritized, resolved, documented, and transitioned into sustainable operating processes.

**Post-Implementation Finance Systems Ownership**

Transition into Finance and Accounting as the enterprise product and systems owner for Workday Financials and related Finance platforms following implementation.

Own ERP governance, configuration standards, release management, enhancement intake and prioritization, access governance, issue resolution, vendor management, and platform controls in partnership with Technology.

Develop and maintain the Finance systems strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with accounting, controllership, business, data, risk, and enterprise technology priorities.

Lead continuous optimization of Finance processes, controls, reporting, automation, and user experience while protecting platform stability and data integrity.

Establish service levels, operating procedures, documentation, support responsibilities, performance measures, and governance routines for sustainable platform ownership.

Build and lead Finance systems capabilities and resources as the operating model develops and organizational needs are approved.

**Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Serve as a trusted advisor to Finance, Accounting, Operations, and Technology executives on ERP strategy, implementation tradeoffs, operating model decisions, and investment priorities. Communicate complex system, accounting, data, and implementation matters clearly to executives, governance committees, auditors, and business stakeholders.

Promote disciplined decision-making, cross-functional accountability, change leadership, and strong partnership across the enterprise.

Perform other duties as assigned and comply with all EagleBank policies and standards.

Qualifications:

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in Accounting, Finance, Management, IT or related field
* 10 years additional relevant experience will be considered in lieu of degree
* 12 years progressive experience in accounting, controllership, or financial systems required, preferably within banking or financial services
* 3 years experience leading or serving as a core team member on a full-lifecycle ERP implementation (Workday Financials preferred)
* Strong technical accounting knowledge and understanding of GAAP and internal control requirements
* Demonstrated experience with chart of accounts design, financial data migration, and reconciliation
* Hands-on experience with Workday Financials or a comparable enterprise ERP platform
* Strong project management skills, including planning, issue and risk management, and executive reporting
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence across departments

**Preferences:**

* Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) MBA or Master of Accounting
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
* Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)-PMI or workday financials certification
* Experience serving as a system or product owner for a financial platform

Don't meet all the requirements? We encourage you to still apply if you think you are the right person to join our community. We are always interested connecting with people inspired by our mission and values. If you aren't hired for this position, your resume will remain available for the next year and might be considered for future openings. Note: You can update your resume as often as needed.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist -EHR/PM
jobs.description:
Description:

**Position Summary**

The Implementation Specialist supports onboarding, implementation, and adoption of TRIARQ Health solutions. Partnering with Client Onboarding leadership, this role coordinates activities, advances client readiness, delivers training, and supports implementations through GoLive.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who anticipates needs, resolves issues, and follows through with precision. This role independently owns assigned workstreams within the implementation strategy set by Client Onboarding leadership. EMR, revenue cycle workflow, and training experience are required.

*What Success Looks Like*

* Owns workstreams and delivers with minimal supervision.
* Anticipates needs and proactively supports implementation and training.
* Builds strong client and cross-functional partnerships.
* Clearly communicates status, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Delivers training that drives confidence and adoption.
* Manages concurrent implementations with precision and adaptability.

*Key Responsibilities*

Implementation Support & Client Onboarding

* Support onboarding and implementation from discovery through GoLive.
* Execute implementation plans and milestones with leadership.
* Lead discovery of workflows, requirements, and objectives.
* Coordinate Product, Support, IT, Client Success, and Revenue Cycle teams.
* Maintain project records and escalate risks, blockers, and concerns.
* Support departmental initiatives and special projects.
* Support system setup, workflow mapping, configuration, and validation.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and GoLive readiness.
* Troubleshoot issues and coordinate internal resolution.
* Develop knowledge of HL7, APIs, sFTP, webhooks, and related technologies.

Client Training & Enablement

* Deliver virtual and on-site training for clinical, administrative, and billing teams.
* Create and maintain guides and onboarding resources.
* Apply adult-learning principles to strengthen knowledge transfer and adoption.
* Evaluate effectiveness and provide post-GoLive reinforcement

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
* 2-4 years in healthcare technology, onboarding, implementation, training, or support.
* Experience with EMR, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, or related technology.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to build relationships and manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools.
* Ability to travel approximately 25%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of HL7, APIs, sFTP, webhooks, and healthcare integrations.
* Familiarity with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Camtasia, Articulate, Adobe Captive or similar tools.

jobs.title: Commercial Onboarding and Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW OF THE POSITION**  
The Onboarding and Payroll Specialist is responsible for executing the end to end onboarding and payroll processes with accuracy, compliance, and exceptional service. This role ensures all candidate documentation, background checks, timekeeping processes, payroll submissions, and client specific requirements are completed according to company standards.

Success in this role requires comfort working with AI powered onboarding tools, automated verification systems, digital payroll workflows, and synthetic/AI teammates to enhance accuracy, reduce manual workload, and accelerate processing timelines. The Specialist collaborates closely with recruiters, compliance teams, and internal operations to create seamless experience for candidates and clients across multiple programs.

**DESCRIPTION OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS** ***(for each duty and function listed indicates % of time to total 100%)*****:**

* Facilitate and manage the complete onboarding process in alignment with state, federal, and client-specific requirements.
* Collect, validate, and process all onboarding documents, leveraging AI-driven document verification tools and digital workflows.
* Initiate, monitor, and adjudicate background checks using automated screening platforms; ensure all results meet contractual and regulatory standards.
* Educate candidates on timekeeping procedures, payroll timelines, and required platforms (including VMS systems when applicable).
* Manage the weekly payroll process, including timecard collection, validation, troubleshooting, and processing through automated systems.
* Partner with candidates, clients, and recruiters to ensure timely approval and submission of timecards.
* Utilize auditing tools to verify timecard accuracy and identify discrepancies before payroll submission.
* Organize and maintain payroll documentation in compliance with ESO standards and audit readiness guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve onboarding or payroll issues efficiently, escalating complex issues when appropriate.
* Support customers and associate expectations with professionalism, empathy, and effective communication.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and timelines in a fast paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Maintain accurate records and performance metrics through digital tracking and analytics dashboards.
* Support special projects and continuous improvement initiatives involving automation, process optimization, and compliance enhancements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum 2 years of HR, onboarding, payroll, or staffing industry experience.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with both human teams and AI/synthetic contributors.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to solve problems and adapt quickly in a demanding environment.
* Basic accounting and payroll knowledge preferred.
* Comfort making recommendations based on data findings and system insights.

**SUPERVISION EXERCISED/ #OF STAFF:**  
None

**LANGUAGE/COMMUNICATION SKILLS** ***(written & verbal)***:

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to interact professionally with candidates, clients, and internal teams.
* Strong discretion and confidentiality when managing sensitive data.

**COMPUTER/SYSTEM SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel (formulas, pivot tables, reconciliation).
* Experience with electronic onboarding systems, VMS tools, or HRIS platforms preferred.
* Comfort using AI-enabled onboarding tools, automated verification systems, and payroll technology.
* Ability to learn new platforms and digital workflows quickly.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:**  
N/A

**WORK ENVIRONMENT/ PHYSICAL OR MENTAL ABILITIES:**  
The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

We are very excited to offer an array of benefit programs for our employees. Internal staff hires working 30 or more hours per week will be offered robust plans including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, accident, LTD, pet discount coverage, legal coverage, identity theft, discount perks, and credit union. Most plans include a generous employer contribution in addition to the employee’s contribution. Eligible employees can enroll with an effective date the first of the month following 60 days of employment. A minimum of 6 paid sick days are offered per year unless part time or covered under a local ordinance that requires a greater number of paid sick days. Paid time off accrues immediately at 2 hours per semi-monthly pay period for full time employees, and a prorated amount for part time employees based on the percentage of a 40 hour work week worked. Accrual increases with tenure at certain anniversary dates. The Company offers 11 paid holidays. The Company also offers a 401k program with an employer match, with employee contributions beginning the month following enrollment.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, disability, protected veteran status, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Pursuant to applicable state and municipal Fair Chance Laws and Ordinances, we will consider for employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Pursuant to applicable state and municipal Fair Chance Laws and Ordinances, we will consider for employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

* Communicate effectively with executive stakeholders through verbal presentations, status updates, and detailed documentation

* Strong skills in strategic planning, process improvement, and business analysis with a focus on equipment finance or financial services

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting purposes
* Experience with management consulting methodologies, large-scale organizational change management, and cross-functional collaboration
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams effectively while managing multiple projects simultaneously
* Familiarity with research techniques, data analysis tools, and analysis skills to inform decision-making processes
* Knowledge of lean management principles, process mapping techniques, and enterprise solutions implementation strategies
* Prior experience working within a consulting firm or managing complex technology projects in an organizational setting is highly desirable

Join us as a Solifi Equipment Finance Implementation Specialist to drive innovation, foster collaboration, and deliver impactful solutions that shape the future of equipment financing. Your expertise will help clients navigate transformative change while advancing your career in a vibrant and supportive environment.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* 401(k)

jobs.title: ACBS Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented ACBS Implementation Specialist to drive the successful deployment of Automated Commercial Banking Systems (ACBS) solutions. In this role, you will be at the forefront of enterprise system integration, ensuring seamless implementation, configuration, and optimization of ACBS platforms. Your expertise will help streamline financial operations, enhance system performance, and support our clients' business objectives through innovative technology solutions. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a passion for systems engineering and software implementation, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact!

**Duties**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of ACBS solutions, including system configuration, testing, and deployment across diverse client environments
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical specifications for system design and integration
* Develop and execute detailed project plans, ensuring timely delivery while managing scope, resources, and risk factors
* Perform system troubleshooting, technical support, and issue resolution during and after implementation phases to guarantee optimal performance
* Integrate ACBS with other enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Pegasystems, database systems (SQL, NoSQL), and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure
* Conduct system architecture design reviews, ensuring compliance with security standards including cloud security, vulnerability management, and system hardening practices
* Document all configuration changes, system updates, and troubleshooting procedures adhering to version control standards

**Requirements**

* Proven experience with software development, implementation, and system integration within enterprise environments
* Strong knowledge of service-oriented architecture (SOA), solution architecture, and systems engineering principles
* Hands-on expertise in database management using SQL-based systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) as well as NoSQL databases
* Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, C#, Java, Shell Scripting or Ruby on Rails for automation and customization tasks
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure including AWS or Azure; understanding of virtualization technologies like VMware or ESXi is a plus
* Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills to liaise effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders
* Ability to troubleshoot complex IT infrastructure issues involving firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, DNS configurations, and network security protocols
* Certifications in relevant areas such as ITIL, AWS Solutions Architect or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect are advantageous
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; additional training in enterprise solutions implementation or systems architecture preferred

Join us to be part of an innovative team dedicated to transforming financial technology through expert system implementation!

Pay: $45.00 - $70.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Implementation Manager (West)
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

#### **What You Will Be Doing:**

You will join Beacon's Clinical Implementation team, reporting to the National Clinical Implementation Director. This is a remote, US-based individual contributor role anchored in our West territory, with travel to customer sites across your assigned region. The role does not carry direct reports, but you will mentor peers and newer specialists and may direct the work of others on implementation projects.

You will own the clinical and operational implementation of Beacon's diagnostic solutions for assigned customers, guiding sleep labs, health systems, and provider organizations from contract pre-signature through confident, sustained daily use of our products. Day to day, that means delivering demos, building implementation plans, running clinical education and training, supporting go-lives, and coaching accounts through adoption after launch.  

This is not a traditional implementation role focused only on deployment and go-live milestones. Your impact is measured by sustained usage, behavioral adoption, and long-term workflow integration. At this level, your influence extends beyond your own accounts: you set the standards, playbooks, and best practices the broader team works from, and you help shape where the clinical implementation function goes over the next several quarters.

The role is highly cross-functional and requires strong communication, systems thinking, empathy, and execution discipline. You will work across clinicians, executives, and frontline staff while maintaining clarity, momentum, and trust throughout the customer journey.  

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York, or the Bay Area.

#### **What Success Looks Like:**

* You own end-to-end implementation execution for your accounts such as kickoff, project planning, milestone tracking, risk identification, and stabilization, and the accounts transition cleanly into steady-state support with decisions and configurations documented.
* You provide virtual and on-site clinical support across every phase of implementation, from pre-planning and education through go-live and post-launch troubleshooting.
* You build implementation plans that account for clinical workflow design, staffing models, order and result routing, patient communication, and administrative processes, and you coordinate resources across Customer Success, Clinical, Technical Services, Support, and Product to keep them on schedule.
* You deliver comprehensive training and demos tailored to each audience (physicians, advanced practice providers, sleep technologists, medical assistants, schedulers, and administrative staff) and maintain the reusable materials, quick-reference guides, and competency checklists that make training repeatable.
* You own adoption outcomes, tracking utilization, ordering patterns, turnaround, and workflow adherence against agreed targets, and delivering refresher training as turnover, new hires, and product changes require.
* You diagnose the root cause of low or inconsistent usage (workflow friction, training gaps, staffing constraints, process breakdown) in situations where the data alone does not give you the answer, and you drive corrective action.
* You partner with clinical and operational leaders to redesign workflows so Beacon is embedded in daily practice, and you connect usage data back to the customer's stated clinical and operational goals.
* You serve as the clinical operational point of contact through pre-sale, implementation, and early adoption, building trusted relationships from frontline staff to the executive level and communicating status, risks, and decisions proactively.
* You act as the clinical subject matter expert on sleep testing workflows and home sleep apnea testing, ensuring clinical messaging and training content align with product capabilities, supporting evidence, and regulatory requirements.
* You exercise independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including how implementations are sequenced, how adoption is measured, and what counts as a stabilized account, and you determine your own approach on first-of-kind customers, new indications, and accounts with no precedent.
* You partner with Regional Sales Managers on clean handoffs, participate in QBRs and renewal or expansion discussions, and surface adoption risks, churn signals, and expansion opportunities early with supporting evidence.
* You give Product structured feedback grounded in real implementation experience, identify recurring friction points, propose scalable solutions, and support go-to-market readiness for new features and indications.
* You mentor and coach peers and newer specialists on strategy, execution, customer judgment, and collaboration, including areas outside their functional skillset, and you build the templates and playbooks that raise the team's standard.
* You prioritize and plan multi-quarter priorities for the clinical implementation function, represent it in cross-team planning with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, and make decisions based on the needs of multiple stakeholder teams and the company as a whole.
* You initiate improvement projects independently, arriving with a defensible approach rather than waiting for direction, where recurring gaps in process, tooling, or enablement limit team outcomes.
* You adhere to all regulatory, compliance, quality, and privacy standards applicable to medical devices and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), including HIPAA, and support audits, documentation, and quality processes as required.

#### **Must-Haves:**

* Active RPSGT certification
* 8+ years of direct experience in sleep medicine, sleep lab operations, or home sleep apnea testing
* Demonstrated experience owning demos, customer implementations, clinical training, or go-live support in healthcare settings
* Experience delivering training and education to both clinical and administrative audiences
* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Support, Marketing, and Product teams
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching peers, and setting standards or best practices adopted beyond your own work
* Experience planning work across multiple quarters and multiple stakeholder groups
* Willingness to travel nationally (up to ~50-75%), including on-site go-live support
* Familiarity with CRM tools, enablement platforms, and project tracking tools
* US-based, anchored in the West territory

#### **Nice-to-Haves**

* **Adoption-focused mindset.** You measure success by sustained usage, workflow integration, and customer outcomes rather than implementation completion alone.
* **Clinical workflow fluency.** You understand sleep lab workflows and how clinicians and their teams operate in practice, not just on paper.
* **Systems and operational thinking.** You see how implementation, training, adoption, workflow optimization, and customer success connect into a single operating system.
* **Independent judgment at scale.** Your recommendations are trusted without close oversight, and you are comfortable defining the approach when no playbook exists.
* **A multiplier effect.** You raise the performance of those around you through mentorship, reusable best practices, and standards that outlast any single implementation.
* **Comfort in a fast-paced environment.** You execute effectively in a high-growth startup where priorities evolve quickly.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, enablement platforms, project tracking tools, and healthcare IT systems (EHR/EMR exposure a plus).
* Experience supporting SaMD or regulated medical device products.
* Prior experience at an early- or growth-stage healthcare company.
* Experience building a function's playbooks, templates, or training curricula from the ground up.

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $155,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

* You mentor and coach peers and newer specialists on strategy, execution, customer judgment, and collaboration, including areas outside their functional skillset, and you build the templates and playbooks that raise the team's standard.
* You prioritize and plan multi-quarter priorities for the clinical implementation function, represent it in cross-team planning with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, and make decisions based on the needs of multiple stakeholder teams and the company as a whole.
* You initiate improvement projects independently, arriving with a defensible approach rather than waiting for direction, where recurring gaps in process, tooling, or enablement limit team outcomes.
* You adhere to all regulatory, compliance, quality, and privacy standards applicable to medical devices and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), including HIPAA, and support audits, documentation, and quality processes as required.

#### **Must-Haves:**

* Active RPSGT certification
* 8+ years of direct experience in sleep medicine, sleep lab operations, or home sleep apnea testing
* Demonstrated experience owning demos, customer implementations, clinical training, or go-live support in healthcare settings
* Experience delivering training and education to both clinical and administrative audiences
* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Support, Marketing, and Product teams
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching peers, and setting standards or best practices adopted beyond your own work
* Experience planning work across multiple quarters and multiple stakeholder groups
* Willingness to travel nationally (up to ~50-75%), including on-site go-live support
* Familiarity with CRM tools, enablement platforms, and project tracking tools
* US-based, anchored in the East territory

#### **Nice-to-Haves**

* **Adoption-focused mindset.** You measure success by sustained usage, workflow integration, and customer outcomes rather than implementation completion alone.
* **Clinical workflow fluency.** You understand sleep lab workflows and how clinicians and their teams operate in practice, not just on paper.
* **Systems and operational thinking.** You see how implementation, training, adoption, workflow optimization, and customer success connect into a single operating system.
* **Independent judgment at scale.** Your recommendations are trusted without close oversight, and you are comfortable defining the approach when no playbook exists.
* **A multiplier effect.** You raise the performance of those around you through mentorship, reusable best practices, and standards that outlast any single implementation.
* **Comfort in a fast-paced environment.** You execute effectively in a high-growth startup where priorities evolve quickly.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, enablement platforms, project tracking tools, and healthcare IT systems (EHR/EMR exposure a plus).
* Experience supporting SaMD or regulated medical device products.
* Prior experience at an early- or growth-stage healthcare company.
* Experience building a function's playbooks, templates, or training curricula from the ground up.

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $155,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Director Clinical Systems Engineering - Remote
jobs.description:
**Crossroads Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Since 2005, Crossroads has been at the forefront of treating patients with opioid use disorder. Crossroads is a family of professionals dedicated to providing the most accessible, highest quality, evidence-based medication assisted treatment (MAT) options to combat the growing opioid epidemic and helping people with opioid use disorder start their path to recovery. This comprehensive approach to treatment, the gold standard in care for opioid use disorder, has been shown to prevent more deaths from overdose and lead to long-term recovery. We are committed to bringing critical services to communities across the U.S. to improve access to treatment for over 26,500 patients. Our clinics are all outpatient and office-based, with clinics in Georgia, Kentucky, New Jersey, North and South Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees and patients.

  

***Day in the Life of a Director, Clinical Systems Engineering***
=================================================================

***Key Responsibilities: Leadership and Delivery***

* Lead the EHR implementation and engineering team, including lead analysts and technical specialists, setting priorities, assigning work, and holding the team accountable for quality and timelines.
* Direct large-scale EHR migrations and consolidations across multiple states and care models, owning the overall delivery plan, sequencing, go-live readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Provide oversight of requirements, specifications, and build artifacts produced by the team, ensuring they are complete, traceable, and audit-ready before sign-off.
* Govern scope, change requests, and downstream impact decisions, and escalate trade-offs with clear cost, risk, and effort recommendations to senior leadership.
* Coach and develop team members, building career paths and technical depth across the team, and create the structure that lets senior analysts lead workstreams independently.
* Serve as the primary escalation point and technical counterpart to EHR vendors, trading partners, and internal IT, including SOW review and vendor performance management.

***Technical Oversight: Interfaces, Integration, Data, and Automation***

* Lead highly skilled technical teams across data, interface, and automation disciplines, with enough hands-on depth to challenge designs, assess vendor proposals, and unblock complex technical issues.
* Oversee the interface and data exchange portfolio, including HL7 v2 and FHIR messaging, laboratory and toxicology results, e-prescribing and EPCS, PDMP, pharmacy and dispensing systems, and reporting and analytics feeds.
* Own data migration strategy and quality for system transitions, including extraction, mapping, validation, and reconciliation of clinical, dosing, and billing data.
* Oversee eligibility, claims, and remittance transaction flows (270/271, 837, 835) in partnership with the revenue cycle team.
* Direct RPA and workflow automation initiatives that reduce manual work across EHRs and operational processes, including tool selection, governance, and maintenance standards.
* Establish monitoring standards for interface queues and error handling and lead root-cause analysis and remediation of major incidents.

***Experience We're Looking For***

* Proven record leading end-to-end EHR migrations or consolidations in a multi-site or multi-state healthcare organization.
* Experience leading large groups of technical teams, including data, interface, and automation specialists.
* Strong technical foundation in healthcare interoperability (HL7, FHIR, X12) and data migration, with the credibility to lead technical staff.
* Behavioral health, SUD, or OTP experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with 42 CFR Part 2.

***Education and/or Experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, information systems, computer science, healthcare administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred. Equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in clinical application configuration, systems analysis, or EHR implementation required.
* Minimum of 2 years of direct people leadership or formal project leadership experience required.
* Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end requirements gathering for clinical or enterprise software initiatives required.
* Hands-on configuration experience with at least one enterprise EHR or practice management platform required; behavioral health, substance use disorder, or OTP platform experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site EHR implementation, consolidation, or data migration required.
* Working knowledge of interfaces and integration (HL7, FHIR, API, SFTP) required. Demonstrated hands-on SQL experience is required and will be assessed during the interview process.
* Knowledge of OTP and OBOT operations, including methadone and buprenorphine dispensing workflows, take-home regulations, and 42 CFR Part 2, strongly preferred.
* Experience with a healthcare clearinghouse and familiarity with revenue cycle workflows preferred.
* Professional certification such as CPHIMS, CAHIMS, PMP, Certified Scrum Product Owner, Six Sigma, or vendor-specific application certification preferred.
* Ability to travel to clinic sites as required to support implementations, go-lives, and workflow assessments.
* Experience building reports, extracts, or dashboards used by operational or executive leadership required; experience owning data validation for a system conversion strongly preferred.
* Healthcare experience is required, with behavioral health or MAT experience highly preferred.

***Benefits Package***
======================

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* PTO
* Variety of 401K options including a match program with no vesture period
* Annual Continuing Education Allowance (in related field)
* Life Insurance
* Short/Long Term Disability
* Paid maternity/paternity leave
* Mental Health Day
* *Calm* subscription for all employees

Change Mgmt & Training Specialist (Remote, 5 Yrs Req Exp)
jobs.description:
Digital Strategy is seeking a **Change Management & Training Specialist** to support the rollout and adoption of new systems, system enhancements, data products, reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities for a federal client.

This is a hands-on role combining **change management, instructional design, training delivery, communications, and user adoption support**. The successful candidate will work closely with product owners, technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users across approximately 20 client offices, including several offices that have recently joined the organization and may have different processes, systems, and adoption needs.

The client’s data and analytics environment includes **Power BI and Databricks**, so the role will also support adoption of dashboards, reports, data products, and self-service analytics capabilities delivered through these platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute change-management and user-adoption plans for new systems, enhancements, data products, and process changes.
* Assess stakeholder impacts, readiness, training needs, and adoption risks across different offices and user groups.
* Develop practical training materials, including job aids, user guides, quick-reference guides, presentations, demonstrations, and FAQs.
* Deliver virtual instructor-led training, system demonstrations, workshops, office hours, and other user-support sessions.
* Support rollout and adoption of **Power BI reports and dashboards, Databricks-enabled data products, and self-service analytics capabilities**.
* Tailor training and change approaches based on user roles, business processes, technical proficiency, and office-specific needs.
* Develop communications that clearly explain what is changing, why it matters, and what users need to do differently.
* Work with product owners and technical teams to incorporate user feedback into future releases and enhancements.
* Support rollout activities and help identify and address barriers to adoption.
* Use modern tools, including AI-assisted content-development tools where appropriate, to efficiently create polished training and communications materials.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in instructional design, organizational development, communications, education, business, information systems, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience** in change management, instructional design, training, user adoption, organizational transformation, or a combination of these areas.
* Demonstrated experience supporting technology or system implementations.
* Hands-on experience developing training materials and delivering virtual or instructor-led training.
* Strong facilitation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-engagement skills.
* Ability to translate technical concepts and system changes into clear, practical guidance for business users.
* Ability to independently develop polished, client-ready deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Federal government consulting experience.
* Experience supporting enterprise-wide system or process changes across multiple offices or business units.
* Experience supporting adoption of **Power BI, Databricks, dashboards, reporting platforms, data products, or self-service analytics**.
* Familiarity with Prosci/ADKAR or other change-management methodologies.
* Experience working in Agile or product-development environments.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools to develop training, communications, or learning content.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can operate at both the strategic and hands-on level—someone who can develop a change plan, create the training materials, deliver the training, work directly with users, and help drive adoption through rollout and beyond.

Join us to be part of a forward-thinking organization committed to empowering clients through innovative solutions! Your expertise will help shape transformative change initiatives that make a real impact across organizations while enjoying the flexibility of remote work.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* U.S. Citizenship

Experience:

* creating training for system rollouts: 5 years (Required)
* delivering live or virtual training: 5 years (Required)
* supporting system or data-product adoption: 5 years (Required)
* OCM + instructional design + training: 5 years (Required)
* Federal consulting : 4 years (Preferred)
* change management, training, or adoption: 5 years (Required)
* Emerging Tech Adoption (Power BI, Databricks, AI Features): 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote
